method: Reviewed packaging, Linux entry/orchestration, Windows orchestration and update plan against current snapshot/audit/test tooling, root fixture paths and current Windows Job helper. Reviewed the provided read-only dependency and instance-baseline records without remote access or credential reads. Corrected only confirmed wrapper exit/log/cleanup-proof defects in ignored preparation files. Verification used syntax checks, pure result/stop-proof fixtures, harmless local Python subprocesses and local Windows child/descendant transport fixtures; no full suite was invoked.

resolvedFindings.impact: The orchestration process returned zero even when a phase failed or had skips; a timeout or stop-query exception could discard output and prevent a retained phase/final result.
resolvedFindings.fix: Persist stdout/stderr directly to flushed files; preserve stop errors and failed proof in result.json; return overall 1 for failure/uncertain stop, 3 for completed runs with skips, and 0 only for two fully passed/stopped phases. A nobody skip continues to root fixtures.

resolvedFindings.impact: A normal runner exit or ignored taskkill result did not establish that descendant processes were gone, and output-budget termination did not bound retained log bytes.
resolvedFindings.fix: Reuse the current audited suspended-start non-breakaway Windows Job controller; require authenticated empty-Job ACK, preserve actual test exit code including 3, cap each output log and await flushed streams. Taskkill is only emergency fallback, never cleanup evidence.

resolvedFindings.impact: LoadState=not-found alone was accepted even with missing or contradictory process fields.
resolvedFindings.fix: Require the full observed six-field state, zero main/control PIDs, stopped ActiveState/SubState, acceptable query status and an empty or absent exact cgroup.

syntax: Python import under -B with Linux-only pwd stub; main not executed

gateChecks.result: blocked by actual audit validator before packaging
blocked by actual audit validator before any full test launch

boundaryReview.threeCleanGate: Package and both Linux phases use actual current validateAuditRecord/prepareRun; Windows validates before creating the Job. No gate bypass added.
boundaryReview.sameSource: Full source manifest hashes and executable bits are rechecked on extraction; Linux entry verifies exact snapshot before and after tests. Current final source digest was not changed by preparation edits.
boundaryReview.linux: PrivateNetwork, empty /etc/codex, independent HOME/CODEX_HOME/temp and separate root/nobody extractions. Root fixture traversal ancestors are 0755; root fixture mutation targets are relocated and service calls mocked.
boundaryReview.windows: Clean HOME/CODEX_HOME/application-data/temp and Git NUL config; denying proxies allow loopback fixtures. This is not OS-level network isolation.
boundaryReview.dependencyInputs: Only the existing third-party node_modules tree is eligible for copying. Provided root read-only record reports 12415 manifest entries and exact dependency input hashes/canonical workspace equivalence; preparation checks do not independently re-attest that remote tree.
boundaryReview.instance: Provided corrected baseline identifies crtest-rw-20261025, R2 release, legacy layer and active idle services. This point-in-time baseline must be refreshed before an authorized update.

limitations: No real Linux systemd unit, root fixture or full suite was executed in this review. Root execution/namespace behavior still requires future isolated acceptance.
No archive transfer, SSH action, online update, external API, personal configuration/credential access or host 110 access occurred.

The initial Windows transport fixtures used source digest d06e446fe909ab676fdbcdc45437bfbcf25e4be8c42eb184e19060d7d87a0c38 while the parent completed product changes. These fixtures test wrapper cleanup only; final gate checks use f17d130352406a43e6625b843024fb503113355f572009549580573891aeee2d.
Preparation review earns zero formal clean-audit rounds and grants no release/full-test authorization. Future source repairs reset the real three-round gate.
